title.narrative: Construction and preparation of the hemodialysis unit at Al-Jadah Health Center in Hajjah Governorate, Republic of Yemen

description.narrative: Completion of the construction and preparation of a kidney dialysis unit as a unit affiliated with Al-Ja’dah Health Center, so that it is ready for operation and to start receiving patients.

It aims to provide a kidney dialysis center as a unit affiliated with the Al-Ja’dah Health Center, which was built and operated by the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center, to contribute to alleviating the suffering of kidney failure patients in the northern regions of Hajjah Governorate.

The northern areas of Hajjah Governorate in the Republic of Yemen lack secondary health services. Given the presence of kidney failure cases in the region that require regular dialysis, and to alleviate the suffering of kidney patients, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center will finance the construction of a dialysis building as a unit affiliated with the Al-Ja’dah Health Center, which was built and operated by the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center.
